title: Lock and check the agent harness configuration for drift
body:
Outcome: a krn harness check records a lockfile of the agent environment (CLI versions, model and effort, MCP servers, skills, hooks, skill overrides) and reports drift against it. Source: .krn/runs/delivery-loop/continuity-research/rss-patterns.md (hlock pattern). Overlaps t-e6zkwse (settings and skills audit) and t-g5vqm2q (Node pin); keep one owner.
Proof: the check exits non-zero on a changed model/effort, MCP set or skill override, and zero on the locked state.
